blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future video and generate actions, yet remain sensitive to task-irrelevant visual perturbations, i.e., changes in visual appearance that should not affect robot behavior. We identify a gap in conventional WAM training: video prediction encourages representations to preserve appearance information, while action generation does not explicitly enforce invariance to task-irrelevant appearance. Data augmentation exposes WAMs to such perturbations but does not require perturbed and nominal observations to produce consistent action representations, and alignment with external pretrained features does not guarantee the desired invariance. To address this gap, we propose PICA-WAM, a self-supervised training framework that casts perturbation invariance as an auxiliary cross-appearance self-alignment task for WAMs. An exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher processes the nominal observation to provide a deeper-layer target, while the online WAM processes a perturbed observation and aligns its shallower-layer action representation to this target through a lightweight projection head. Across four strong WAMs evaluated on RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO-Plus, EBench, and a real robot, PICA-WAM consistently improves robustness under visual perturbations, preserves nominal performance in simulation, and raises the real robot success rate. PICA-WAM further reduces the sensitivity of video features to task-irrelevant appearance and its propagation into actions, as shown by paired layer-wise diagnostics. Code: https://github.com/YudeZou/PICA-WAM-release
blocks.zh: World Action Models(WAMS)联合预测了未来的视频并生成动作,然而仍然对任务无关的视觉扰动保持敏感,即视觉外观的变化不应影响机器人的行为. 我们找出了传统WAM培训中的一个缺口:视频预测鼓励表达来保存外观信息,而动作生成并没有明确强制对与任务无关外观的偏差. 数据扩增使WAM面临这种扰动,但不需要扰动和名义上的观测来产生一致的行动表示,与外部预先训练的特性相配合并不能保证所期望的无变化. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议PICA-WAM, 这是一种自我监督的培训框架,将扰动性变化作为WAM的辅助交叉出现自我调节任务. 一个指数移动-平均(EMA)的老师处理名义上的观察,以提供更深层的目标,而在线的WAM则处理扰动的观察,并通过一个轻量级的投影头来使其更浅层的动作表现与这个目标相配合. 在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus、E Bench和一个真正的机器人上评价了四个强大的WAM,PICA-WAM在视觉扰动下不断提高稳健性,保持模拟中的名义性能,并提高了真正的机器人成功率。 PICA-WAM进一步降低了视频功能对任务不相干外观的敏感性并传播到动作中,如配对分层诊断所示. 代码:https://github.com/YudeZou/PICA-WAM-放行.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World Action Models (WAMs) build robot policies on top of pretrained video generators, coupling predictions of how a scene will evolve with the actions that drive it ( Yuan et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ; Ye et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Cai et al., 2026b ) . Video–action co-training transfers the dynamics prior of large-scale video pretraining into control, and WAMs now approach saturation on standard manipulation benchmarks such as LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and RoboTwin ( Mu et al., 2024 ; Mu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Yet these models remain brittle when observations depart from the training distribution ( Hong et al., 2026 ) . On LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) and RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Random ( Yuan et al., 2026a ) , shifts in appearance, viewpoint, sensing, and scene configuration can substantially reduce success. The task goal remains the same, but the policy must act under unfamiliar observations and starting conditions.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式(WAMs)在预先训练的视频生成器上搭建机器人政策,将场景如何演变的预测与驱动它的行动相配合(袁等,2026年b;李等,2026年b;叶等,2026年b;王等,2026年b;蔡等,2026年b). 视频-行动协同训练将大规模视频预训前的动态转移到控制,而WAMs现在接近于LIBERO(刘等,2023年)和RoboTwin(缪等,2024年;缪等,2025年;陈等,2025年)等标准操纵基准上. 然而,当观察与培训分布不同时,这些模型仍然不灵活(Hong等,2026年)。 在"LIBERO-Plus"(Fei等,2025年)和"RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Random"(Yuan等,2026a)上,外观的转变,观点,感知,和场景的配置可以大大降低成功率. 任务目标不变,但政策必须在不熟悉的观察和起始条件下执行。

blocks.en: We view this brittleness as a gap in the training objectives of WAMs. The video prediction objective requires faithful reconstruction of appearance details such as lighting and texture, while reliable control calls for consistent actions when the same underlying task state is observed under different task-irrelevant appearance variations, and joint video–action training does not explicitly enforce this consistency. As the action expert reads video-stream representations, task-irrelevant appearance variation leaks into the action pathway.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,这种不灵活是萨摩亚妇女大会培训目标中的一个空白。 视频预测目标要求忠实地重建外观细节,如照明和纹理等,而可靠的控制则要求在任务相关外观变化不同的情况下观察到相同的基本任务状态时采取一致的行动,而联合视频-行动培训没有明确强制实施这种一致性. 由于行动专家读取了视频流表达,与任务无关的外观变异会渗入行动路径.

blocks.en:
Existing approaches address this gap only partially. (i) Data augmentation ( Tobin et al., 2017 ; Kostrikov et al., 2020 ) exposes the model to perturbed observations but never requires their representations to agree with those of their nominal counterparts. The resulting invariance is incidental rather than enforced: in our layer-wise analysis, augmentation lowers appearance sensitivity in intermediate video layers, but sensitivity rises above the unaugmented baseline in layers 21–25 (Figure 3 , left). (ii) External representation alignment regularizes WAM features toward priors from outside the model, such as semantic vision encoders ( Qiu et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , 3D trajectory fields ( Yang et al., 2026b ) , 4D tracking features ( Miao et al., 2026 ) , or rendered Gaussian fields ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . These priors provide semantic and geometric guidance, but alignment to an external teacher does not keep the representations of the same underlying task state consistent under visual perturbations. This leaves a need for explicit cross-appearance supervision. (iii) Self-alignment constructs representation targets from the generative model itself, without an external encoder. In image and video generation, Jiang et al. (2025a) and Chefer et al. (2026) align shallower, noisier features to deeper, cleaner features of an exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher of the model ( Tarvainen and Valpola, 2017 ; Grill et al., 2020 ) , matching the gains of alignment to external encoders ( Yu et al., 2024 ) .
These methods align differently noised versions of the same sample, without matching nominal and perturbed observations of the same underlying task state. Self-alignment also remains underexplored in WAMs, where joint video–action prediction raises the question of whether to align the video stream, the action stream, or both.
blocks.zh:
现有办法仅能部分弥补这一差距。 (一)数据增强(Tobin等,2017;Kostrikov等,2020年)使模型暴露出扰动观测,但从未要求其表述与名义对应方的表述一致. 由此产生的偏移是偶然的,而不是强制的:在我们分层分析中,增强降低中间视频层的外观敏感性,但敏感度高于第21至25层的未增强基线(图3,左)。 (二)对外代表对标外的WAM特征进行规范化,如语义视觉编码器(邱等,2026;颜等,2026;王等,2026a),3D轨迹场(杨等,2026b),4D跟踪功能(苗等,2026),或使高斯场(张等,2026b). 这些前科提供了语义和几何指导,但与外部老师的对接并不能在视觉扰动下保持相同基本任务状态的表达一致. 这就需要明确的交叉出现监督。 (三)自我调节从基因模型本身构造出代表目标,没有外部编码器. 在图像和视频生成中,Jiang等人(2025年a)和Cefer等人(2026年)将更浅的,噪声的特征与模型的指数-移动-平均(EMA)教师的更深,更清洁的特征相匹配(Tarvainen and Valpola, 2017;Grill等人, 2020年),与外部编码器对接的得分相匹配(Yu等人, 2024年).
这些方法使同一样本的不同噪声版本一致,没有匹配同一基本任务状态的名义和扰动观测结果. 在WAMs中,自我调整也仍然未得到充分探讨,其中联合视频-动作预测提出了是将视频流,动作流,还是两者都对齐的问题.

blocks.en: To this end, we propose PICA-WAM , a self-supervised training framework that promotes visual P erturbation I nvariance via an auxiliary C ross- A ppearance self-alignment task in WAM s. An EMA teacher of the WAM reads the nominal observation at a lower noise level and provides a deeper-layer target. The online WAM reads a perturbed observation of the same underlying task state and aligns its shallower-layer action representation to this target through a lightweight projection head (Figure 2 ). Each pair thus spans three gaps. The appearance gap supplies the invariance signal. The noise-level and layer gaps, which Jiang et al. (2025a) identified as key ingredients of self-alignment, make the target stronger than the student it supervises. We apply the objective to the action stream, which directly encourages consistency in the representation used for control while leaving the video prediction objective unchanged. In our ablations, this choice outperforms aligning the video stream or both streams. The teacher and the head are discarded after training, so PICA-WAM adds no parameters and no computation at inference and applies to any WAM with a layered backbone.

blocks.en: We evaluate PICA-WAM on four strong WAM backbones across simulation and real-world settings: Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026b ) on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Random and LIBERO-Plus, LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026b ) on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Random, InternW0- Δ \Delta ( Miao et al., 2026 ) on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Random and LIBERO-Plus, and OpenWAM- α \alpha ( Wang et al., 2026b ) on EBench ( Gao et al., 2026 ) and a real robot. PICA-WAM consistently improves robustness over the corresponding baselines and achieves the best results among the compared methods on all three simulation benchmarks: built on InternW0- Δ \Delta , it reaches 74.7% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Random and 93.3% on LIBERO-Plus, and built on OpenWAM- α \alpha , it reaches 61.4% on EBench. Even without embodied pretraining, it brings Fast-WAM to success rates comparable to those of models with large-scale embodied pretraining. Paired analyses further show that it reduces both the appearance sensitivity of video features and its propagation into actions, including under perturbation families unseen during training.

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows: • We propose PICA-WAM , a self-supervised training framework for WAMs in which the action representation from a perturbed observation is aligned to a cleaner, deeper target computed from the nominal observation by an EMA teacher of the model, and that needs no external encoder, no additional data, and no inference-time computation. • We design a paired diagnostic protocol that traces a visual perturbation from layer-wise features to executed actions, and show that augmentation alone leaves late video layers appearance-sensitive and lets this sensitivity reach the action, whereas PICA-WAM reduces both. • We demonstrate consistent robustness gains on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Random, LIBERO-Plus, EBench, and real-world manipulation under visual perturbation across four strong WAMs with and without embodied pretraining, while preserving in-distribution performance.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Early work synthesizes future frames and infers actions from them ( Du et al., 2023 ) , or conditions a policy on video pretraining and predictive representations ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2024 ) . Later models jointly denoise video and actions ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) , and current WAMs scale this recipe with stronger video backbones, action experts, and embodied pretraining ( Yuan et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Ye et al., 2026b ; Cai et al., 2026b ; Miao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Guo et al., 2026 ) .
Yet WAMs remain brittle under visual perturbations ( Fei et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026a ) , and their predicted futures can hallucinate training-domain content ( Wang et al., 2026a ) .
Remedies include inference-time activation steering ( Hong et al., 2026 ) and training-time priors from outside the model: semantic features from pretrained encoders such as DINOv3 and V-JEPA or from text ( Qiu et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Feng et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) , geometric supervision such as 3D trajectory fields, 4D tracking features, and Gaussian fields ( Ma et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Miao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and distractor-invariant object slots ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . Data augmentation and domain randomization ( Tobin et al., 2017 ; Kostrikov et al., 2020 ) expose a policy to appearance variation but supervise each observation independently. Self-Guided WAM ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) uses an EMA teacher, but to supervise future dynamics rather than cross-appearance agreement.
None of these methods constrains WAM representations across task-irrelevant appearance variations of the same underlying task state. PICA-WAM instead casts perturbation invariance as a cross-appearance self-alignment task, without any external encoder.

blocks.en:
REPA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) aligns intermediate diffusion-transformer features with a pretrained visual encoder to accelerate training and improve generation, and follow-up work extends it to end-to-end VAE tuning ( Leng et al., 2025 ) and video generation ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Several of the semantic WAM methods above follow the same recipe. Such targets inherit the properties of the external encoder: frozen pretrained encoders, including DINO- and SigLIP-style ones, are strongly appearance-coupled, and the action information decodable from their features collapses under noise and blur ( Yeom et al., 2026 ) .
Self-alignment instead constructs targets within the model. SRA ( Jiang et al., 2025a ) aligns shallower-layer features of a student at a higher noise level with deeper-layer features of an EMA teacher at a lower noise level. Self-Flow ( Chefer et al., 2026 ) noises the student’s tokens at heterogeneous levels while the teacher observes the cleaner input, scaling self-alignment to image, video, and audio generation. These approaches train a student to agree with a slowly updated teacher on a different view of the same input, but their views differ in noise level or network depth, not in task-irrelevant appearance, so the agreement does not encode appearance invariance. PICA-WAM makes task-irrelevant appearance the difference between the two views: the teacher reads the nominal observation and the student a perturbed observation of the same underlying task state.

blocks.en: Simulation Benchmarks. RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Random ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026a ) trains on 50 clean demonstrations for each of 50 bimanual tasks, recorded with a fixed background, default lighting, no distractors, and a fixed table height. Each task is evaluated for 100 episodes in this clean setting and in a domain-randomized setting that randomizes background textures, lighting, distractor clutter, and table height and uses unseen language instructions. LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) evaluates policies trained on the four LIBERO suites ( Liu et al., 2023 ) on 10,030 perturbed tasks along seven dimensions: robot initial state, language instruction, lighting, background texture, sensor noise, object layout, and camera viewpoint. EBench ( Gao et al., 2026 ) evaluates policies on 26 tasks: 19 mobile manipulation tasks and 7 table-top dexterous-and-precise tasks in household, retail, and industrial scenes. Policies are evaluated through the official online platform, in which the episodes of each task vary the objects, the background, the instruction, or a mix of them.

blocks.en: 4.2 Does Augmentation Enforce Invariance?
blocks.zh: 4.2 增量是否强制执行内变?

blocks.en: To test the argument of Section 3.2 that augmentation-only training leaves intermediate representations unconstrained, we design a paired diagnostic protocol. It compares the three controlled Fast-WAM variants (Section 4.1 ), which differ only in whether they are trained on perturbed clips and whether they are aligned. Each perturbed LIBERO-Plus observation is paired with the nominal observation of the same simulator state under the same noise seed, so that the two inputs differ only in how the scene is observed. The protocol traces the perturbation from features to executed actions at three levels. (i) Layer-wise sensitivity is the feature distance between the two observations divided by the distance between the nominal observations of two different states in the same episode. Raw feature distances differ in scale across layers and models, and normalizing by a change in task state removes this difference, so that a value of 1 means that the perturbation changes the features as much as a change in task state does. (ii) A layer-band intervention replaces the video features of one layer band in a nominal prediction with those from the perturbed observation, which tests whether the sensitivity remaining in that band shifts the action. (iii) Trajectory drift is the distance between the end-effector positions reached by executing the action chunks predicted from the two observations. We report separately the seen perturbation families, whose type is contained in T T (Gaussian, motion, and zoom blur, and fog), and the unseen ones (glass blur, lighting, background, and camera viewpoint on LIBERO-Plus). All diagnostics use the single-step video denoising of deployment. Appendix B details how the pairs are constructed and how each metric is computed.

blocks.en: Augmentation leaves late video layers appearance-sensitive. Figure 3 (left) shows the video-stream sensitivity on unseen families. Relative to the Baseline, +Aug lowers the sensitivity in the intermediate layers, but the sensitivity rebounds in layers 21–25 and exceeds that of the Baseline, so augmentation does not remove appearance variation from the video features that the action stream reads in these layers. PICA-WAM is the least sensitive from layer 2, although it aligns only the action stream: constraining the action stream also shapes the video features through joint attention.
blocks.zh: 增强会留下后期视频层外观敏感. 图3(左)显示了对看不见的家庭的视频流敏感性。 相较于"基线",+Aug会降低中间层的灵敏度,但灵敏度在"21-25"中反弹并超过"基线",因此"增强"并不能去除动作流在这些地层所读取的视频功能的外观变化. PICA-WAM是第2层中最不敏感的,尽管它只协调动作流:限制动作流也会通过联合关注来塑造视频功能.

blocks.en: Residual sensitivity reaches the action. Figure 3 (right) reports the layer-band intervention, normalized by the action deviation of the Baseline on the same observation pairs. Under +Aug, bands 15–20 and 21–25 carry the largest leakage, and layers 21–25, where the sensitivity rebounds, retain 84% of the leakage of the Baseline. blocks.en: Alignment reduces sensitivity on seen and unseen families. Table 1 reports the sensitivity of both streams at a shallower layer (layer 8). blocks.en: We evaluate on an ARX-Lift2 dual-arm robot with one head camera and two wrist cameras. For each lighting condition, we run five trials per task with a different object layout in each trial, and a trial succeeds if the robot picks up the object. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced PICA-WAM , a self-supervised training framework that casts perturbation invariance as an auxiliary cross-appearance self-alignment task for WAMs. An EMA teacher of the model computes a target from the nominal observation at a lower noise level and a deeper layer, and the action representation of a perturbed observation is aligned to this target. The teacher and the head are discarded after training. Across Fast-WAM, LingBot-VA, InternW0- Δ \Delta , and OpenWAM- α \alpha , PICA-WAM improves success rates under visual perturbations on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Random, LIBERO-Plus, EBench, and a real robot. Paired diagnostics show that it reduces the appearance sensitivity of both streams and the resulting trajectory drift, including on unseen perturbation families.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了PICA-WAM,这是一种自我监督的训练框架,它将扰动性变化作为WAM的辅助交叉出现自我调节任务. 模型的EMA老师在低噪音和更深的地层中计算出从名义观测中得出的一个目标,被扰动的观测的动作表现与这个目标一致. 老师和头部在训练后被丢弃. PICA-WAM在RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Random、LiBERO-Plus、E Bench以及一个真正的机器人上, 发作的诊断表明,这降低了两条溪流的外观敏感性以及由此产生的轨迹漂移,包括在看不见的扰动家族上.

blocks.en: We replay LIBERO demonstrations in the LIBERO-Plus base environment and record the full simulator state at five control steps per episode. For the lighting, background, and camera families, we load the corresponding LIBERO-Plus scene, which differs from the base scene only in its scene description or camera pose, and set it to the recorded state. We verify that the resulting simulator state and end-effector pose match the nominal ones. We use one variant per LIBERO-Plus difficulty level for each of these families. For the sensor-noise families, we apply the LIBERO-Plus corruption functions to the nominal render at five severities. All observations of a state share the same noise seed.
blocks.zh: 我们在LIBERO-Plus基地环境中重放LIBERO演示,并记录每集5个控制步骤的完整模拟状态. 对于照明,背景,相机家庭,我们加载相应的LIBERO-Plus场景,这些场景仅在其场景描述或相机姿势上与基场不同,并设定为所记录的状态. 我们确认,由此产生的模拟状态和最终效应与名义状态相符。 我们使用每个LIBERO-Plus难度级的变体。 对于感官噪声家庭来说,我们把LIBERO-Plus腐败功能应用到名义渲染分出五分. 对一个状态的所有观测都具有相同的噪声种子.

blocks.en: For each layer, we compute the relative ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distance between the perturbed and the nominal features, and divide it by the same distance between the nominal features of the state and those of a different state in the same episode, at least eight control steps apart. The video features are the hidden states from which each layer computes its video keys and values, restricted to the observed-frame tokens. The action features are the action-token inputs of each layer at the first denoising step, where the action input is the same noise for both observations. We pool distances over perturbed observations and report 95% bootstrap confidence intervals over states.

blocks.en: We partition the 30 video layers into the bands 0–4, 5–9, 10–14, 15–20, 21–25, and 26–29. For each band, we replace the video hidden states of the nominal observation with those of the perturbed observation, recompute the keys and values of these layers, and denoise the action again with the same noise. We report the resulting action deviation from the nominal action, normalized by that of the Baseline on the same observation pair, and compare PICA-WAM with +Aug by a paired Wilcoxon test.
blocks.zh: 我们把30个视频层分为0–4、5–9、10–14、15–20、21–25和26–29等。 对于每个波段,我们用扰动观测的画面来取代标点观测的隐藏状态,重新计算出这些地层的键和值,再用同一种噪音来对动作进行揭发. 我们报告由此导致的与名义动作的偏差,按照同一对观测对的基线的偏差,并将PICA-WAM与+Aug比对成对的Wilcoxon测试.

blocks.en: Each predicted 32-step action chunk is executed open-loop from the recorded state in the base scene, which the perturbations do not change physically.
